node.statement: Dependency-closed assembly. By node 1.3.4 and e<=1, ||(u_{T,n}-T_n)A||<=(1+epsilon)||u_{T,n}-T_n||||A||<=2*K_u_local*e||A||, and likewise ||A(u_{R,n}-R_n)||<=2*K_u_local*e||A||. Bilinearity yields u_{T,n}A-A=(u_{T,n}-T_n)A+(T_nA-A) and A u_{R,n}-A=A(u_{R,n}-R_n)+(A R_n-A). Combining the preceding estimates with validated nodes 1.3.1 and 1.3.2 proves both bounds in node 1.3 with the universal K_a=max(K_T,K_R)+2*K_u_local. This derivation does not invoke pending node 1.2.
